text:
Jared: Fairview just dropped their SIG/CAIQ PDF in the intake form, asking for a POC and pricing outline. tagging @Priya (need security intake). link: https://files.redwood.example/fairview/sig_2026_q1.pdf
DeployBot: Document uploaded to secure-bucket://intake/fairview/3432109876/sig.pdf (sha256: 9f2a...) :white_check_mark:
Maya S.: thanks. quick Q — does the POC need sample data? they mentioned 'payment tokens' in the questionnaire.
Anita (Fairview): quick clarification — we'll provide anonymized sample tokens, not raw card data. PII scope: name + email + tokenized payment id. POC will run for 2 weeks.
Priya (Security): Ok noted. main things I need: 1) confirmation of deployment model (hosted vs dedicated vs private) 2) design diagram for data flow 3) the completed CAIQ sections they flagged as "outstanding".
Erik: From SE side — they want low latency for inference, likely 8k context, and we'll need to know if BYOK/KMS is required. If private, estimate for Dedicated is needed for pricing.
Jared: Fairview requested recommended config + ballpark monthly for dedicated GPU + support. Can we get a draft estimate before EOD tomorrow?
Priya (Security): I can own the questionnaire review. Assigning to myself. Please upload the network diagram and sample config to the secure share: `s3://redwood-secure/intake/fairview/3432109876/` (share perms: redwood/sec-team, eng-se).
Maya S.: I'll coordinate the POC environment. If they need private VPC we should collect their VPC peering details and expected sustained qps.
Anita (Fairview): We'll drop the network diagram and POC scope by EOD today. Also: compliance asks about data residency — we need EU region only.
Priya (Security): EU-only noted. Also, CAIQ responses we mark as "control owner: redwood-inference" where applicable. I'll start with the high-risk controls and post comments inline.
Erik: For pricing, rough calc: Dedicated pool (4xA10) + 99th p99 latency SLO → estimate $XXk/month. I'll put a detailed worksheet in the share.
Jared: tagging @Maya S. and @Priya — can one of you confirm whether the POC needs a signed DPA or can be covered under our standard eval terms?
Priya (Security): If they insist on EU-only and BYOK, legal will want a DPA + DSA addendum. I'll flag to legal now.
Maya S.: I'll schedule a kickoff call for tomorrow 10am PT with Fairview and include Priya + Erik. agenda: scope, data flow, timeline, and pricing.
Anita (Fairview): 10am PT works. thanks all.
Jared: Great — I'll update the CRM and set the intake status to "assigned -> security_review". Will follow up after the kickoff. :thumbsup:
Priya (Security): Started questionnaire pass; will add comments inline and post checklist when done.
DeployBot: Reminder: intake ticket #SF-4732 created and linked to thread.
Jared: on it, thanks everyone.
